title: BASIC# Small Compiler Subset BSBC Execution Parity Corpus Expansion
purpose: Prove the bounded Subset 0 lane executes source through independent reader, parser, semantic resolver, BSBC encoder, BSBC loader, and BSharp VM while production BytecodeVirtualMachine and Ruby Runtime remain separate exact referees.

allowed: checking source to BSharp IR to independently emitted BSBC bytes to independently loaded trusted model to independent BSharp VM execution
comparing independent BSharp VM event results against the production BytecodeVirtualMachine referee
comparing independent BSharp VM results against the Ruby referee runtime
comparing final snapshots and save documents across independent VM and both referees
proving the Elderedd canonical path direction while keeping the DKLab compatibility bridge intact
forbidden: implementing BCS servers, accounts, payments, or network services
Project Oracle or Demon Killer work

output_schema.fixture_count: number of sealed execution parity fixtures checked
output_schema.all_pass: true only when independent VM execution matches locked expectations, the production VM referee, and Ruby referee runtime results

acceptance_rules: The BSBC execution parity tool must pass in the Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
Every accepted fixture must execute through SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCVirtualMachine from a model validated by SmallCompilerSubsetBSBCLoader.
The subset BSBC emitter must prove exact bytes against the production BytecodeEmitter referee.
The subset BSBC loader must prove exact trusted-model parity against the production BytecodeLoader referee.
The production BytecodeVirtualMachine must remain a separate referee and must not be called from the independent VM implementation.
Every accepted fixture must match both the production VM referee and Ruby referee runtime event results, final snapshot, and save document.
The v0.1.77 dedicated fixture must execute independently loaded Profile 7 BSBC through the independent subset VM.
The DKLab compatibility bridge must remain present and protected in this build.
No Profile 8, syntax, production runtime behaviour, bytecode rename, BCS implementation, Project Oracle, Demon Killer, or bridge removal work is allowed.
